lines.t: Where is the new training room?
On the second floor, next to the meeting room.
What time does the training start, and how long is it?
At nine. It’s two hours long, with a short break.
Ms. Kim. She helps our team with customer service.
What kind of activities do we do?
We practice phone calls and answer questions from customers.
How many people are in the group?
There are eight of us. Bring a notebook. We work in pairs.
